name: @ttdu/office-connect
description: Keep TTDU results in the office's own systems: Paperless-ngx (document archive), Odoo and ERPNext (attach to customer/employee records), Twenty (CRM). Talks only to their published HTTP APIs; contains none of their code. Used as the optional 'deliver' last step of the TTDU office runner.
author: Park Jihoon (Tools That Don't Upload) <hello@toolsthatdontupload.com>
